title: Our LS Swapped Supercharged Blazer Hits the Dyno! INSANE Torque
coverage: full transcript read (0:04-12:24); dyno pulls are mostly [Music]; car name 'Blazer' comes from the title (transcript never says the car name)

notes.fact: Sam's yellow C5 Corvette (bone stock) and a 'butternut' third-gen shown
El Camino ('Elko') finished and loaded; facing ~1,300 miles and seven days of racing

cars.build_version: LS small-block + blower, Rocky Mountain Race Week (earlier than the Texas Speed 427 version)
cars.owner_driver: George (implied: 'George, you had the party pulleys on'; low confidence)

engine.family: GM LS small block (title says LS swapped; transcript says it makes more on the small block than on the previous big one)

power_adder.drive: originally 33% overdrive ('party pulleys'), changed to 15% overdrive; lower pulley 59 swapped for 52 (units not stated)

fuel.street: pump gas (93) via lower port injectors; separate fuel rails

ecu.notes: Tune switch wired by Zach: race mode vs 93-octane street tune; for street, ignition off, flip switch, remove blower belt

street_mode.desc: Bolt-in blower lock to stop the rotor spinning on the street (pump gas through lower injectors would heat the blower without methanol through it); plate made by Ty over two throttle bodies for drivability; hole cut in license plate cover for airflow

cooling.notes: small radiator; 210 F on dyno; overheated to 230-240 F loading into trailer; idle hangs high on pump gas (throttle blade not centered, shimmed)

suspension.notes: No anti-roll bar fitted at time of dyno (one on hand); car wheelied on the dyno and is expected to wheelie hard

dyno.result: no reading; car wheelied/lifted off the dyno, ran very rich

dyno.notes: caption 'one thousand twelve ... the torque eleven forty five'; over 1,000 lb-ft by 4,000 rpm; hp/torque assignment medium confidence; whp vs crank not stated

dyno.note: Spark plugs pulled after pull 2 looked 'like factory'; no further pulls

failures.cause: undersized radiator / no time to fix; runs hot

parts.part: blower lock (stops blower for street driving)

targets.notes: Run well and survive race week rather than max power; hoped for ~17-20 psi rather than 23

mechanics: methanol race fuel vs pump-gas street tune switch
